crossRefs.note: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who…

so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection…

translations.web: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.
translations.bsb: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.
translations.kjv: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
translations.asv: knowing that whatsoever good thing each one doeth, the same shall he receive again from the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
